title: The full suite keeps headroom under its darwin ceiling as tests are added
goal: A full python3 _tools/tests.py run on darwin takes at most three quarters of max_seconds (15 of 20 s) on the reference host, by speeding the slowest files the test.run rows name, so a sprint that adds tests inside existing ones does not reach the ceiling. Answers SP-evkj4avq, whose workers saw full runs of 18.4, 18.8 and about 19 s against the 20 s darwin ceiling.
